mapper.select: SELECT id, stage_code AS stageCode, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_active AS isActive FROM stage WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, stage_code AS stageCode, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_active AS isActive FROM stage ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, stage_code AS stageCode, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_active AS isActive FROM stage WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage (stage_code, description, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{stageCode}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
